description: Run one Locus tool by name for a US address or place and get cited public records back: every fact names the agency source and date. Use it for a single question or re-run it for the addresses you follow to see what is newly on file. Free tools answer directly. Paid tools first return their exact price and accept payment in _meta["x402/payment"]; a place Locus does not cover returns a free diagnostic, never a paid guess. Install agent skill: npx @velinussage/locus-agent-skill add.

arguments.description: Arguments for the selected catalog tool (the tool's own inputSchema from locus_search_tools).

name.description: Canonical Locus catalog tool name. Paid tools keep their hyphenated REST slugs.

name: locus_execute
title: Execute a Locus catalog tool
